with asof as (select max(position_date) as d from position_snapshots),
cash as (select pr.legal_entity_id as eid, sum(ps.source_market_value) as amt from position_snapshots ps join portfolios pr on pr.id = ps.portfolio_id, asof where ps.position_date = asof.d group by 1),
cl as (select pr.legal_entity_id as eid, cm.amount as amt, cm.confirmation_status as st, date_diff('day', asof.d, cm.due_date) as dd
       from cash_movements cm join portfolios pr on pr.id = cm.portfolio_id, asof where cm.movement_type like 'cal%' and cm.notice_kind like 'cal%' and cm.due_date >= asof.d),
agg as (select eid,
  coalesce(sum(amt) filter (where st = 'confirmed' and dd <= 30), 0) as c30,
  coalesce(sum(amt) filter (where st = 'confirmed' and dd > 30 and dd <= 60), 0) as c60,
  coalesce(sum(amt) filter (where dd <= 30), 0) as a30,
  coalesce(sum(amt) filter (where st <> 'confirmed'), 0) as unconf
  from cl group by 1)
select cast(date_trunc('month', asof.d) as date) as month, le.entity_code as entity,
  cast(coalesce(cash.amt, 0) as decimal(18,2)) as available_cash,
  cast(coalesce(agg.c30, 0) as decimal(18,2)) as calls_due_within_30_days_confirmed,
  cast(coalesce(agg.c60, 0) as decimal(18,2)) as calls_due_31_60_days_confirmed,
  cast(coalesce(cash.amt, 0) - coalesce(agg.c30, 0) as decimal(18,2)) as cash_after_confirmed_calls,
  cast(coalesce(cash.amt, 0) - coalesce(agg.a30, 0) as decimal(18,2)) as cash_after_all_noticed_calls,
  cast(coalesce(agg.unconf, 0) as decimal(18,2)) as calls_not_yet_confirmed
from legal_entities le cross join asof left join cash on cash.eid = le.id left join agg on agg.eid = le.id
